source.basis: Exact passages in the Owner-supplied Mark 3 handoff; not a hash or independent retrieval of an earlier private walkthrough.

quotes.text: I approve both of your recommendations.

Start with the core model and an explicit broker refinement. Investigate both boundaries sufficiently to compare coverage and complexity. Do not exclude necessary execution behavior merely to keep the model small. Include relevant broker state directly whenever separate checking is inadequate. Preserve the full platform requirements and continue whole-system optimization research alongside this work.

A with substantial routine delegation, followed by testing whether representative workflows suffer avoidable interruptions. If they do, that provides concrete amendment classes worth considering under B.

I approve both of your recommendations.

However, there were some parts in your thinking process and how they were recorded that I would like to go over.

You said that the researchers are going to decide whether increased communication/delegation and interaction results in better results versus usage quota consumption. However, I also wanted to note that, we know already that all features are going to have drawbacks in one way or another. The more features we add, the more it's going to bloat the active process on the computer, consume more quota, and tank performance. However, it's imperative that we make all of these changes configurable and customizable. It comes back to this central idea that was found with Pi Agent or DeepSeek Harness. More configurability and plugin compatibility is almost always some of the best ways to approach this harness architecture.

Additionally, I wanted to highlight the upside of agent communication. Take this own session for example. We are communicating to return a handoff to the main research session that is going to take this questionnaire and re-integrate it into the research workflow, publish more research and ideas into the repository, and repeat the process necessary until we end up with a concrete architecture that we can work on and delegate autonomously.

To help fill out the questionnaire, I'm consulting another agent because of convenience. I can't process all parts/ideas of the questionnaire myself. It's hard to manage an entire process all by yourself as a developer looking to create programs that are pushing the limits of what's possible with agents. We are also racing to finish this against real multi billion dollar companies. Just imagine if I could communicate with you, and you could communicate with the head session, and I as the supervisor and leader could see it all happening and unfolding with my eyes. It's ingenious architecture.

Obviously with Recursion, if prompted, I want there to be an element of Autonomy with Recursion, but I want there to be a strong interactive and conservative side that reliably serves the basis of Recursion.

The harness should be very aligned with the user's goals. Whether it be researching and planning for something that requires extensive research and autonomy, or working collaborative to implement a feature.

I want it to have innovative and groundbreaking features while maximizing configuration, compatibility, performance, and quota preservation. That's why this research into kernels and everything is so important and should require a lot of depth

Recursion should stay closely aligned with the user’s goals and adapt its working style to the task. It should support extensive autonomous research and planning when requested, and close collaboration when the user wants to develop something together. Within agreed boundaries, it should use initiative and carry work through. Throughout that work, it should preserve intent, incorporate feedback, surface consequential changes, and remain easy to inspect, redirect and stop.

But I think it should include how Recursion pushes the boundary of agent communication, terminal multi-plexing, being able to communicate between compute instances and nodes, and more. We seriously are pushing the boundaries of what's possible

System Performance, Cache Performance, Configuration, Compatibility, Agent Communication, CLI Performance, Autonomy, Harness Orchestration, Headless Architecture, Plugins, MCPs, and more. We have so much that we need to research and I feel like the current processes are only scratching the surface.

Recursion should push the boundaries of agent communication, terminal multiplexing, and coordinated work across compute instances and nodes. It should enable agents to consult one another, exchange relevant context and evidence, and coordinate work across compatible harnesses, while users can observe, converse with and steer that work through persistent, attachable terminal views. These capabilities should preserve coherent goals, permissions, progress and resource accounting across sessions and machines. Recursion should pursue innovative and groundbreaking features while maximizing configuration, compatibility, performance and quota preservation. Optimization research must explicitly span system and cache performance, configuration, compatibility, agent communication, CLI performance, autonomy, harness orchestration, headless architecture, plugins, MCPs and their interactions. Deep comparative research into kernels, execution models, communication protocols and resource management must establish how those capabilities work together and how their benefits can be demonstrated.

qualifications: Compare both boundaries sufficiently for coverage and complexity; smallness or speed alone cannot omit required behavior.
Retain all six M1 obligations and process ownership, consultation, queue saturation, RESET/replay, relaunch, configuration and update/Stop interactions.

Core model and refinement together must cover the obligations before formal freeze; incorporate relevant broker state when independent checking is inadequate or a bounded interleaving violates an aggregate obligation.
Small interface probes precede model freeze; whole-system optimization proceeds alongside, then language comparison followed by storage comparison.
Substantial routine delegation may organize research, consult, assign eligible workers and change tactics within current grants, accepted outcomes and limits.
Accepted intent, deliverables, acceptance requirements, authority, privacy exposure and resource ceilings remain Owner amendments.
Communication, peer advice and persistent identity do not confer authority; do not add repetitive approvals for already authorized routine choices.
Test representative workflows for avoidable interruptions requiring actual amendments; only then identify precise classes for a later bounded proposal.
Meaningful Owner visibility, participation, steering and revocation remain required.

rulings.summary: Start with the smallest aggregate plus explicit independently checkable bounded broker refinement; compare both boundaries deeply and include necessary broker state when separate checking is inadequate.
Retain Owner-only actual GoalSpec amendments with substantial authorized routine delegation; test avoidable interruptions before proposing exact future delegated amendment classes.

Task-aligned autonomy and collaboration retain initiative within agreed boundaries, intent, feedback and Owner inspection/steering/Stop. Communication, delegation and interaction are required, with visible questionnaire-assistant-to-Head exchange across sessions and nodes.

Configuration, compatibility and deep whole-system optimization are central. Preserve required capabilities while comparing mechanisms, activation, defaults and kernel/service/plugin placement, including rich/lean and disabled costs and complete human/workflow benefits.
